topics.topic: AI Skilling, MyWAVES & DD Free Dish Reforms
topics.why_in_news: Government launched AI skilling initiatives, MyWAVES platform and DD Free Dish reforms to strengthen digital inclusion, public broadcasting and India’s creator economy ecosystem.
prelims_quick_notes: AI skilling initiatives aim to build future-ready digital workforce.
Focus on Artificial Intelligence, emerging technologies and innovation ecosystem.
MyWAVES platform launched to strengthen digital content ecosystem.
DD Free Dish is India’s free Direct-to-Home (DTH) broadcasting service.
DD Free Dish supports low-cost public broadcasting access.
WAVES OTT platform supports digital streaming of public content.
Orange Economy refers to creative and digital content economy.
Supports digital inclusion, employment generation and media accessibility.
important_facts: DD Free Dish operated by Prasar Bharati.
DD Free Dish mainly benefits rural and low-income households.
Orange Economy linked with creativity, media and cultural industries.
AI skilling important for digital economy and workforce transition.
Prasar Bharati is India’s public service broadcaster.
exam_relevance: Important for Science & Technology, Governance and Digital Economy.
Useful for AI, digital inclusion and public broadcasting topics.
Can be linked with Digital India, skilling and emerging technologies.
prelims_traps: DD Free Dish is operated by Prasar Bharati, not private operators.
OTT platforms and DTH services are not identical.
Orange Economy relates to creative economy, not agriculture.
